vibe: Black luxury streetwear, anime-inspired fashion, high-end minimal premium

scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight uppercase font-bold

layout_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Asymmetric grids for marketing, dense 'Control Room' grids for builder and admin.

surface_strategies.cards: Flat solid background #111111, 1px border border-white/10, no default shadow. Hover: slight translate-y-1, border-white/30, subtle white glow drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)].
surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glass: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 border-b border-white/10
surface_strategies.buttons: Primary: bg-white text-black rounded-none hover:bg-gray-200 transition-colors uppercase tracking-widest font-bold text-sm px-8 py-4. Secondary: border border-white/20 bg-transparent text-white hover:bg-white/5
surface_strategies.admin_dashboard: Control Room Grid. Sharp edges (rounded-none). Dense layout, 1px solid borders border-white/10. Dark mode background.
surface_strategies.builder_interface: Split screen layout. Canvas on left, sticky controls on right. Technical 'retro-futurism' look for sliders and toggles.

components.hero: Full screen height. Overlay image with bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] via-[#050505]/50 to-transparent. Massive typography aligned bottom-left or center.
components.product_grid: Image dominates 85% of card space. Minimal text (Product Name, Price) aligned left below image.
components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Massive outline text 'PREMIUM ANIME STREETWEAR' in text-8xl text-transparent font-black uppercase whitespace-nowrap opacity-10.
components.filters: Sidebar filter. Checkboxes with minimal styling, custom Shadcn Select for sorting.
components.forms: Inputs: bg-[#111111] border-white/10 rounded-none focus:border-white focus:ring-0 text-white placeholder-gray-600.
components.badges: bg-[#E60000] text-white text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest px-2 py-1 absolute top-4 left-4 z-10

interactions.hover: High contrast shifts. Text elements turn pure white on hover. Images scale slightly.
interactions.animations: Use Framer Motion for page transitions and staggering lists. Elements should fade in and slide up slightly. Keep it premium, not jumpy.
interactions.accessibility: Always ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Focus states must have white ring 2px offset.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using pure React/Tailwind for marketing and Shadcn components for complex interactions like dropdowns or admin dashboard.
Do not use card components with soft shadows. Strictly adhere to the dark, high-contrast, flat aesthetic.
Import Unbounded and Satoshi fonts from Google Fonts or local font sources.
Implement the Custom T-Shirt Builder utilizing a technical, precise layout with raw inputs and clear visual canvas.
Implement Admin Dashboard utilizing strict grid structure, full screen height, and data-dense tables.
Remember to include data-testid for all interactive elements.
Do NOT use placeholder images. Rely exclusively on the media URLs provided here.
Install lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
Install framer-motion for UI animations and micro-interactions.
Install @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react for sharp, modern icons.
